fields.description: Burj Binghatti Jacob & Co Residences is a branded residential tower in Business Bay, developed with the watch and jewellery house. Its named villa, Sky Mansion and penthouse collections use different layouts, with pool terraces and larger upper-floor homes. It remains distinct from Binghatti’s other branded developments.

overview: Jacob & Co describes a collection spanning villas, Sky Mansions and penthouses, including full-floor and duplex homes. The selected residence’s plan determines its accommodation and services.
research.locationNote: Business Bay, Dubai. Confirm the particular residence’s orientation, access and final approved outlook rather than relying on concept images.

research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 20% down payment, 50% during construction and 30% on handover. This is an attributed portal reference, not a verified current dated contract. Confirm fees and any outstanding balance.
